# PDF.js 6.5.438

Pinned browser display, worker and renderer builds from the `pdfjs-dist` npm package, with standard fonts and WebAssembly decoders. Apache-2.0; see LICENSE and individual font/decoder license files. Only loaded when a learner opens the original-paper reader. No external CDN or runtime package install.

- https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
- https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.5.438.tgz
- https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/examples/

The reader fetches selected public source URLs in the browser. It does not add original contest PDFs to this repository or send answer drafts to those hosts.
